title: Painting the Campfire
content: Painting expeditions are close to home these days. This time I just walk to the backyard to capture the warmth of the campfire.As William Shakespeare said, "Fire that's closest kept burns most of all."View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)Smooth the rescue husky chews on a deer's leg bone that he found deeper in the forest.
